tokens.name: dark-blue
tokens.usage: Brand, structure, navigation. Headings (via heading-color), the nav button, active tab underline, applied filter pill fill, footer, tooltip, lightbox and dark toast surfaces, price text, the count badges on the cart and favourites icons. White on it is 18.72:1. The shadow scale is tinted with it.

tokens.name: medium-blue
tokens.usage: Links and action links, focus rings on light surfaces (2px, 2px offset), facet counts, section eyebrows. 7.20:1 against white in either direction; fine as text on white.

tokens.name: light-blue
tokens.usage: Tint for navigation surfaces: outline-button and panel-row hover, open filter pill, boxed accordion fill. Background only, never text; dark-blue on it is 12.78:1.

tokens.name: dark-green
tokens.usage: Commerce only: the buy button, checkout, place order, in-stock dot, New badge, brand line on the product tile. White on it is 6.65:1. Green never navigates.

tokens.name: medium-green
tokens.usage: Commerce accent on marks. Mid-tone: never takes white text (2.32:1); pair with dark-blue.

tokens.name: light-green
tokens.usage: Commerce tint: buy-button hover fill, applied coupon chip, success message ground. Background only; dark-green on it is 5.44:1.

tokens.name: dark-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icon accent where uWeed informs or invites: blog category labels, the small label above the heading of an informing block, the icon on a pink icon disc. White on it is 6.07:1; on light-gray it is 5.57:1 and on light-pink 4.90:1. Pink is never a button.

tokens.name: medium-pink
tokens.usage: No job in the interface yet. Mid-tone: dark-blue text only (white is 1.96:1).

tokens.name: light-pink
tokens.usage: Behind small marks only: the blog category label and the pink icon disc. Never the background of a block, band or page, and never in the buying steps. Dark-pink on it is 4.90:1.

tokens.name: medium-orange
tokens.usage: Worth noticing, softer than red: rating stars, Bestseller badge, low-stock dot, the edge and icon disc of the warning note. Never an alarm. Always dark-blue on it (9.21:1), never white (2.03:1).

tokens.name: light-orange
tokens.usage: Heads-up tint: the background of the warning note. Background only; dark-blue on it is 17.39:1.

tokens.name: medium-red
tokens.usage: The one attention colour, for what must not be missed: sale price, discount badge, form errors, destructive actions, the favourites heart (its count is dark blue). White on it is 5.05:1, so it carries small white text. Darkened from #EE2E31 in October 2026 to pass AA.

tokens.name: light-red
tokens.usage: Error tint: invalid field and error message ground. Background only; medium-red text on it is 4.45:1, large text and icons only.

tokens.name: dark-gray
tokens.usage: Body copy on white (10.86:1) and light-gray (9.96:1); the unavailable button's border and label; struck original prices; second lines in panels.

tokens.name: medium-gray
tokens.usage: Quiet text and the unavailable colour: dates, hints, breadcrumb links, unselected tabs, placeholder; disabled label and border; UI marks. On white it is 5.02:1 and on light-gray 4.61:1, so small text passes on both. Darkened from #767676 in October 2026 so the hint text inside fields passes; the brand book grey (#999999) was too faint for text.

tokens.name: light-gray
tokens.usage: Grouped-block surface, input fill, gallery frame, disabled fill, attribute chips. Not interchangeable with white. Dark-gray on it is 9.96:1.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: In the palette; the system uses dark-blue for depth and ink instead.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background and card surface; text on every dark tone (text on a dark surface is white, not near-white).

tokens.name: font-color
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of dark-gray for body copy on white and light-gray.

tokens.name: heading-color
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of dark-blue for headings on white and light-gray.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The hairline: card, input and divider borders. Carries the palette's slight blue tint. The one value for every thin line; the #E4E4E4 named in two old specs is retired.

tokens.name: film-oos
tokens.usage: The sold-out film: 60% light-gray laid over a whole product tile, pointer-events none.
